question: Train A leaves station M at 8:00 a.m. and reaches station N at 3:00 p.m. on the same day. Train B leaves station N at 10:00 a.m. and reaches station M at 3:00 p.m. on the same day. Find the time when Trains A and B meet.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Time taken by A = 7 hours (8 a.m. to 3 p.m.) and B = 5 hours (10 a.m. to 3 p.m.).

Let total distance = LCM(7, 5) = 35 units ⇒ Speed of A = 5 units/hr, Speed of B = 7 units/hr.

Distance covered by A before B starts (8 a.m. to 10 a.m.) = 5 × 2 = 10 units.

Remaining distance = 25 units. Time to meet = 25 ÷ (5 + 7) = 25/12 hours = 2 hrs 5 mins.

Meeting time = 10:00 a.m. + 2 hrs 5 mins = 12:05 p.m.

**∴ The correct answer is 12:05 p.m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Train A leaves at 8:00 a.m. and arrives at 3:00 p.m. (Total time = 7 hours)

Train B leaves at 10:00 a.m. and arrives at 3:00 p.m. (Total time = 5 hours)

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Time = Distance ÷ Relative Speed

 Total Distance = LCM(7, 5) = 35 units

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the total distance between station M and station N be D km.

⇒ Speed of Train A = D/7 km/hr

⇒ Speed of Train B = D/5 km/hr

⇒ Train A starts at 8:00 a.m. and Train B starts at 10:00 a.m.

⇒ In 2 hours (8:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m.), distance covered by Train A = 2 × (D/7) = 2D/7 km

⇒ Remaining distance = D − 2D/7 = 5D/7 km

⇒ Now, both trains are moving towards each other.

⇒ Relative Speed = (D/7) + (D/5) = (5D + 7D) ÷ 35 = 12D/35 km/hr

⇒ Time taken to meet after 10:00 a.m. = Remaining distance ÷ Relative Speed

⇒ Time = (5D/7) ÷ (12D/35)

⇒ Time = (5/7) × (35/12) = 25/12 hours

⇒ 25/12 hours = 2 hours and (1/12 × 60) minutes = 2 hours 5 minutes

⇒ Meeting time = 10:00 a.m. + 2 hours 5 minutes = 12:05 p.m.

**∴ The correct answer is 12:05 p.m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed (Opposite Directions)

When two objects move in opposite directions, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds: S = S₁ + S₂.

Relative Speed (Same Direction)

When two objects move in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference of their individual speeds: S = S₁ − S₂.

Meeting Time Formula

Meeting Time = Initial gap between them ÷ Relative Speed.
